_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Reliability and Maintainability (R&M) Program Plan
summary: Describes the Contractor's Reliability and Maintainability (R&M) program, including Built-in Test (BIT) procedures, controls, and flow-down provisions, giving the contracting activity a basis to evaluate the program and verify compliance with specified R&M requirements.
use_relationship:
This plan describes the Contractor's Reliability and Maintainability (R&M) program, how it will be conducted and the requirements, controls, monitoring and flow down provisions levied on Subcontractors and Vendors.  It describes the R&M, including Built-in Test (BIT), procedures and tasks to be performed and their interrelationship with other system related tasks.  The principal uses are to provide the contracting activity a basis for review and evaluation of the Contractor's R&M program and for determining contractual compliance to the specified R&M requirements.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, intended use information, and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task described in the contract.

This DID should be tailored appropriately to each program.

This DID replace DI-SESS-81613.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The Reliability and Maintainability (R&M) Program Plan shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The R&M Program Plan shall identify and describe the activities planned by the Contractor for implementation of the R&M program, and shall include:

children.title: Organizational chart
children.content: providing visibility into the resources, management and organizational structure of those responsible and accountable for the conduct of Reliability, Maintainability and BIT tasks.

children.title: Identification of the quantitative and qualitative R&M and BIT requirements and verification methods
children.content: specified in the solicitation or contract.

children.title: List of required R&M, and BIT Tasks (CDRLs)
children.content: with description and corresponding reference to the sections in the solicitation or contract.

children.title: Integrated schedule for conducting all reliability, maintainability, and BIT tasks
children.content: including the relationship to engineering design reviews and program milestones (for example, systems requirements review, preliminary design review, critical design review, production readiness review, etc).

children.title: Reliability growth planning curve(s)
children.content: that was integrated with the program's master schedule, plotting reliability against test time (or life units) to meet the quantitative requirement(s) specified in the solicitation or contract. Also, include the rationale for the initial reliability, planned growth rate, test resources and growth model used.

children.title: Description of how the R&M and BIT tasks
children.content: (e.g. models, allocations, predictions, fault trees, critical items lists, failure mode, effects and criticality analyses, etc.), including those of subcontractors, that will be conducted and the procedures for comparing their status and results to plan.

children.title: Design guidelines
children.content: (e.g. Operational Mode Summary/Mission Profile (OMS/MP), Failure Definition Scoring Criteria (FDSC), derating, stress analysis, thermal models, etc.) to be used for the reliability, maintainability and BIT tasks (e.g. models, allocations, predictions, failure mode, effects and criticality analyses, etc.).

children.title: List Government Furnished Information
children.content: necessary to support R&M design, development, and test activities and identify the use of R&M data sources (e.g., service maintenance data collection systems).

children.title: Description of the intended use of GIDEP
children.content: to promote and facilitate the sharing of R&M information.

children.title: Test and demonstrations
children.content: planned for reliability, maintainability and BIT (e.g. accelerated tests, BIT demonstrations, Maintainability demonstrations).

children.title: Interrelationships of reliability, maintainability, and BIT tasks
children.content: including how the resulting data will be integrated with other system oriented tasks (for example, life cycle cost analyses, level of repair analyses, availability analyses, trade-off studies, etc).

children.title: Failure Reporting Analysis and Corrective Action System process
children.content: to be used as well as any other data collection requirements and procedures, including a sample of the failure analysis forms.
